name: Product Bundles, Bulk Discount, Quantity Discount, BOGO Discount, and Buy X Get Y by WowRevenue
author: WowRevenue

sections.description:
🥇 First-ever WordPress plugin for increasing average order💲value.
📈 Boost your revenue without increasing the marketing cost.
💕 A plugin by WPXPO, that empowers 60K+ businesses!
📞 Dedicated support team with 4.9/5 customer satisfaction on Trustpilot!

😲 Free Demo | 🔥 WowRevenue Pro | 📃 Documentation

WowRevenue is a proven solution specially crafted to boost the WooCommerce store’s revenue by increasing the average order value. Its effective marketing campaigns help you start upselling and cross-selling instantly. As a result, you can enjoy better revenue without increasing the number of customers. So you don’t need to spend more on customer acquisition.

✅ Normal Discounts
✅ Product Bundles
✅ Mix and Match Bundles
✅ Quantity/Volume Discount
✅ Buy X Get Y Offers
✅ Frequently Bought Together
✅ Double Order
✅ Buy X Get Y Bundle (Coming Soon)
✅ Next Order Coupon (Coming Soon)
✅ Spending Goal (Coming Soon)
✅ Countdown Timer (Coming Soon)
✅ Stock Scarcity (Coming Soon)

Explore how you can increase your WooCommerce store’s revenue.

How 🤔 Can WowRevenue help you?

All of WowRevenue’s campaigns are designed and developed to boost your revenues and average order value. However, all of them have unique benefits and use cases. The following are the best possible use cases for the campaigns.

Normal Discounts

According to many researchers, more than 90% of visitors don’t purchase at the first visit. WowRevnue’s discount campaign can help you make irresistible offers and boost sales.

Product Bundles

Almost 50% of customers buy only a single item. But you can encourage them to buy more by bundling multiple products together and offering a special discount.

Mix and Match Product Bundles

Don’t know which products to bundle? Let your customer create their own bundle using WowRevenue’s Mix and Match Product Bundle campaign. And don’t forget to offer discounts to grab their attention.

Volume/Quantity Discount

Do you want to increase bulk purchases? The volume discount campaign can help you to do that. It helps to offer discounts based on product quantity and set different pricing tiers. So the customers who regularly purchase the same items will be encouraged to make bulk orders.

Buy X Get Y

Flopped products are increasing your inventory cost. But with this campaign, you can convert the cost into opportunity. You can offer slow-moving items for free or at a discounted rate.

Frequently Bought Together

Smartphone companies have stopped offering chargers and earphones for cross-selling. Using the frequently bought-together campaign, you can also use this strategy for your WooCommerce store.

Explore how you can create different campaigns and increase your AOV!

Increase Conversion with FOMO

WowRevenue also offers exclusive ways to create FOMO (fear of missing out) to ensure a better success rate. Be sure to check them out.

Animated Add to Cart: It animates the Add to Cart button to encourage the shoppers to add products to the cart sooner rather than later.

Countdown Timer: You can create limited-time discount offers and add a countdown timer. So the shoppers will feel they might miss the offer if they don’t act now.

Free Shipping: Free shipping is a proven tactic to increase conversions and the average order value.

Placement Flexibility to Maximize Sales

WowRevenue lets you place discount offers on different pages on your WooCommerce stores so that customers are encouraged to buy more products than they initially intended to.

Product Page Discount: Showcase attractive discount offers on your selected product pages.

Cart Page Discount: Increase cart size and boost sales effortlessly by setting up offers on cart pages.

Checkout Page Discount: Showcase irresistible offers on checkout and create a FOMO to encourage even more sales.

Thank You Page Offers: Implement post-purchase upsell to further entice customers to spend more.

Customize Positioning & Look for More Engagement

WowRevenue helps you create attractive offers, and empowers you to control their in-page positioning and look for more engagement. The rest is up to you, explore the following opportunities and make the best use of them.

Customize Positioning:

WooCommerce Pages: While creating a discount campaign, you can choose the page on which you want to display it.

Pop-Up: You can also showcase special offers in pop-up. It ensures that potential buyers see it and encourages them to grab it.

Floating: Displaying the offers in a sticky floating bar would increase engagement and ensure all visitors see offers.

Customize Text, Color, Layout & More: Customize the text of the discount offer. Modify its color, spacing, alignment, and more. Also, set a custom Add to Cart button text to grab customer’s attention.

Manage & Monitor Campaigns Effortlessly

With WowRevenue, you have full control over how you create and launch discount campaigns in your WooCommerce store.

Run and Manage Multiple Campaigns at Once: Set up multiple campaigns and launch them without a hassle. Edit them at any time for more customization.

Get Previews Of Campaigns Before Launch: Get an offer preview for each campaign so that you know how it will look on the live page, ensuring more engagement.

Schedule The Offers Ahead of Time to Maximize Sales: Plan your campaigns and set scheduled sales that suit your marketing strategy.

Real-Time Analytics To Track Performance: A/B test campaign performance and optimize your strategy accordingly. Track analytics such as average order value, impressions, and conversion rate to find out what’s working and what’s not.

Other Wow Plugins!

We have more useful plugins for WooCommerce and WordPress users. Take a look at them:

💝 WowStore: An all-in-one solution to build gorgeous-looking and professional WooCommerce stores with various conversion-focused features.

📦 WholesaleX: A collection of dynamic features for setting advanced pricing and discounts based on user roles. You can use it for creating complete B2B or B2B+B2C hybrid stores.

🧲 WowOptin: The next-generation opt-in plugin for collecting leads, increasing sales, and boosting conversions. It is powered by a canvas-like opt-in builder and advanced placement & targeting options.

📃 PostX: The #1 News Magazine plugin powered by the first ever dynamic site builder for Gutenberg. With its rich library of Templates, you can build any kind of News, Magazine, or Blogging site with three simple steps.

Author

Developed by WPXPO. Contribute to Revenue on Bitbucket and join the party.

📗 Translations

Revenue plugin is compatible with WPML Plugin and also it works perfectly with loco translate plugin.
You can Translate Revenue on translate.wordpress.org.
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0.0 or greater
  • PHP version 7.3 or greater
  • MySQL version 5.6 or greater

Automatic installation

Automatic installation is the easiest option as WordPress handles the file transfers itself and you don’t even need to leave your web browser.

  1. Go to your WordPress Plugin installation menu (Dashboard > Plugins > Add New)
  2. In the search field type “Revenue” and press enter.
  3. “Install Now” and then click “Active”

Manual installation

For Manual installation, you download our product from WordPress directory uploading it to your web-server via your FTP or CPanel application.

  1. Download the plugin and unzip it
  2. Using an FTP program or CPanel upload the unzipped plugin folder to your WordPress installation’s wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu (Dashboard > Plugins > Installed Plugins) within the WordPress admin.

Upgrading

Automatic update working great for this plugin. If you customize the plugin make sure to store a backup before update.

Sometimes because of the permalink issue during the plugin update, just go to WordPress > Settings > Permalinks and hit the ‘Save’ button.
sections.faq:
Is WowRevenue easy to use for beginners?

Yes, WowRevenue is designed and developed in a way that both beginners and experts can use it with ease.

Do I need any coding knowledge to use WowRevenue?

No, you don’t need any coding knowledge to use WowRevenue.

Will I get Support for WowRevenue?

Yes, we have a dedicated team for WowRevenue to provide on-demand support and assistance.
